hero.sub: Paint your own doormat as the sun goes down, with drinks, island bites and a DJ, at a landhuis in Saliña.

story.title: Skip the fridge magnet. Paint your own doormat.
story.p1: Most souvenirs end up in a drawer. This one ends up at your front door. At Ambience you spend an evening at a Curaçao landhuis painting a coir doormat with your own design, with a drink next to your brushes and music in the background.
story.p2: You don’t need to be able to draw. We work with stencils, our hosts show you how, and by half past eight your doormat is dry and wrapped for the flight home. The evening is for adults only, and we keep it to {cap} guests so the table stays sociable.
story.imgAlt: Cocktail at sunset under the palm trees in Curaçao

exp.title: What the evening includes
exp.c1: Choose a stencil (palm leaves, the Handelskade skyline, “Bon Bini”, your family name) or bring your own idea. Doormat, paint, brushes and apron are included, and a host helps you at every step.
exp.c1alt: Guest painting a design during a paint and sip evening
exp.c2: You start with a welcome drink. After that the bar is open for cocktails, wine and beer, and you can add a bites platter, a hookah or a bottle for your table.
exp.c2alt: Friends toasting with cocktails in Curaçao
exp.c3: Our DJ plays Caribbean, Afro and soulful house at a volume that still lets you talk. The MC keeps the evening moving and makes sure nobody paints alone.
exp.c3alt: DJ playing a sunset set on a controller

flow.title: The evening, hour by hour
flow.t1d: Check in at the landhuis, collect your welcome drink and pick a seat at the long table.
flow.t2d: Pick your stencil or sketch your own design. Your host demonstrates the technique and you start painting.
flow.t3d: The light turns gold around half past six. This is when most guests take their photos.
flow.t4d: Platters and hookahs come out while you add the last details.
flow.t5d: Your doormat is dry and wrapped to travel. The bars of Pietermaai are ten minutes away if you want to keep the night going.

loc.title: Find us in Saliña
loc.p: A landhuis is one of Curaçao’s historic plantation houses. Ours is in Saliña, in the middle of Willemstad: about ten minutes by car from Punda, Pietermaai and the cruise terminals, and fifteen from Jan Thiel and Mambo Beach.
loc.l1: Thursday to Sunday · check-in 5:00 PM · experience 5:30 – 8:30 PM
loc.l2: Landhuis in Saliña, Willemstad, Curaçao. We send you the exact address and directions once you’ve booked.
loc.l3: There is parking at the landhuis. A taxi from most hotels takes 10 to 15 minutes, and we can call one for your ride back.
loc.alt: Willemstad waterfront in Curaçao lit up at night

items.a: Ambience is a sunset sip and paint evening in Willemstad, Curaçao. Instead of a canvas you paint a coir doormat that you take home. The evening includes a welcome drink, a DJ and an MC, and runs Thursday to Sunday from 5:30 to 8:30 PM at a landhuis in Saliña. Check-in opens at 5:00 PM.

A ticket is ${pp} per person. A group of {groupSize} pays ${group} in total. The price covers your doormat, all materials, guidance from a host, a welcome drink and the DJ and MC. Table upgrades with hookah, bites and a bottle are optional.
No. We paint with stencils and a simple dabbing technique, and a host helps you at every step. Most of our guests have never painted before.
Yes. We serve alcohol and hookah, so every guest has to be {age} or older. Please bring a valid ID.

items.q: Is it a good idea for a date night or a bachelorette party?
items.a: Yes. Couples usually book two seats at the long table. A group of {groupSize} pays ${group} in total, and for bigger bachelorette parties, birthdays or team outings we can host a private evening or come to your villa.

items.q: Can I take my doormat on the plane?
items.a: Yes. The doormat measures 40 × 60 cm and fits flat in a standard suitcase. The paint is dry by the end of the evening and we wrap the mat for travel.

items.q: I’m visiting on a cruise ship. Can I join?
items.a: Yes, if your ship stays in port for the evening. The landhuis is about ten minutes by taxi from the Mega Pier and Mathey Wharf. Check your all-aboard time before you book: the evening ends at 8:30 PM.

items.q: How many people join each evening?
items.a: No more than {cap}. Weekends fill up first, so we suggest booking before you travel.
Showers on Curaçao are usually short, and the landhuis has covered terraces, so the evening goes ahead. If we ever have to cancel, you choose between another date and a full refund.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: You can change or cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before your evening. After that the booking is non-refundable, but someone else may take your seat.
Whatever you would wear for drinks on a terrace. We hand out aprons, but acrylic paint doesn’t wash out, so leave your favourite white linen at the hotel.

pages.title: Things to Do in Curaçao at Night: 7 Evening Ideas | Ambience
pages.description: Seven things to do in Curaçao at night, from Punda Vibes and the bars of Pietermaai to a sunset sip and paint evening at a landhuis in Willemstad.
pages.nav: Things to do in Curaçao at night
pages.h1: Things to do in Curaçao at night
pages.intro: Curaçao’s beaches get most of the attention, but the island is just as good after dark. These are the evenings we recommend to our own guests, ours included.

sections.h: 1. Paint your own doormat at sunset
sections.p: From Thursday to Sunday, Ambience hosts a sip and paint evening at a landhuis in Saliña. You paint a coir doormat with a welcome drink in hand while a DJ plays, and you’re done by 8:30 PM with the rest of the night ahead of you. Tickets are ${pp}, and evenings are limited to {cap} guests.
Every Thursday evening the old town of Punda turns into a free street party with live music, local art, food stands and fireworks. It’s the easiest way to meet the island’s own crowd.

sections.h: 3. Cross the Queen Emma Bridge after dark
sections.p: The floating pontoon bridge between Punda and Otrobanda is lit at night, with the Handelskade waterfront behind it. It’s free and takes ten minutes, and it is the photo most people take home.
The restored mansions of Pietermaai hold most of Willemstad’s cocktail bars and live-music venues, all within walking distance of each other.
Several operators run catamaran trips along the coast that come back after sunset, usually with drinks and snacks on board.

sections.h: 6. Dance at Jan Thiel or Mambo Beach
sections.p: On weekend nights the beach clubs at Jan Thiel and Mambo Beach become open-air dance floors with DJs, sand underfoot.

sections.h: 7. See Otrobanda’s murals in the evening
sections.p: Guided walks take you past the street art of Otrobanda once the heat has gone out of the day.
Ambience ends at 8:30 PM, which leaves time for dinner or drinks in Pietermaai afterwards. On a Thursday you can still catch Punda Vibes on the way.

faq.q: What time is sunset in Curaçao?
faq.a: Between roughly 6:15 PM in winter and 7:00 PM in summer. Curaçao lies close to the equator, so the time changes little through the year.

faq.q: Do I need to book evening activities in advance?
faq.a: For Ambience, yes: evenings are limited to {cap} guests and weekends fill up first. Bars and Punda Vibes need no booking.

pages.intro: A sip and paint evening gives the whole group something to do together before the night out, and the bride goes home with a doormat painted by her friends.

sections.p: Six seats cost ${group} in total, which is $62.50 each. Bigger groups take several sets of six at the same long table, up to {cap} guests per evening. Add the Bottle, Hookah & Bites upgrade if you want the table set for a celebration.

For a party of your own, book a private evening at the landhuis or have us come to your villa with tables, doormats, paint, hosts and a DJ. We can prepare stencils with the couple’s names and the wedding date.

items: One shared doormat for the couple’s new home, signed by everyone
Matching doormats with the wedding date
A surprise design the bride only sees when she sits down

sections.p: The evening ends at 8:30 PM. The bars of Pietermaai are about ten minutes away by taxi.

faq.q: Is there a minimum group size?

pages.title: Team Building in Curaçao: Creative Sip & Paint Outing | Ambience
pages.description: A creative team building activity in Curaçao: paint doormats together at a landhuis or at your office. For 8 to 60 colleagues, with your logo on the stencil.
pages.intro: A team outing works when people talk to colleagues they don’t usually talk to. Painting side by side at one long table does that, without trust falls or a quiz master.

sections.h: What a team evening looks like
sections.p: Your team arrives, gets a drink and sits down at the long table. A host explains the stencil technique, a DJ plays in the background, and two to three hours later everyone has a doormat for their own front door or for the office.

sections.h: At the landhuis or at your office
sections.p: Book a private evening at the landhuis in Saliña, or let us come to you. We bring tables, doormats, paint, aprons and hosts, and we leave the room as we found it.

items: Stencils with your logo or company values
Bar, bites and DJ are optional

faq.q: How far ahead should we book?
faq.a: As early as you can. We plan private events around our regular Thursday-to-Sunday evenings, so popular dates go first.

faq.q: Can you put our logo on the doormats?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the logo as a vector file and we cut a stencil for your team.
